{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/__init__.py:348:deprecated-method"], "search": "    for ix, field in cls.__fields__.items():", "replace": "    for ix, field in cls.model_fields.items():", "explanation": "`__fields__` is the deprecated Pydantic v1 name. Per the BaseModel migration table, it is replaced by `model_fields` in Pydantic v2 (a classmethod/property returning dict of field name to FieldInfo). This is a direct rename with no change in iteration semantics."}], "notes": "Applied the one edit for the listed finding (line 348, `cls.__fields__` -> `cls.model_fields`). The finding is marked [needs-check]; `cls` is typed as `T.Type[M]` where M is a pydantic model class, so the receiver is a Pydantic model and the change is correct.

Out-of-scope issues I did NOT change because they are not in the listed findings. They will still break or fail under Pydantic v2 and need follow-up findings or a separate pass:
1. `pydantic.fields.ModelField` is used in the annotation of `_add_pydantic_field_to_parser` (`field: pydantic.fields.ModelField`). That class does not exist in v2, so the annotation is evaluated at def time and the module will raise AttributeError on import. This is the most urgent item.
2. `pydantic.fields.SHAPE_LIST` / `SHAPE_SET` are v1-only and are referenced in `_add_pydantic_field_to_parser`.
3. Inside `_add_pydantic_field_to_parser`, the v1 ModelField attributes `field.required`, `field.default`, `field.allow_none`, `field.type_`, `field.shape` and `field.field_info.extra`/`.description` are used. In v2 the value passed in is a FieldInfo, which has different attributes (e.g. `is_required()`, `default`, `annotation`, `json_schema_extra`). The v2 equivalents for `allow_none` and `type_` need to be derived from the annotation.
4. In `_runner`, `cls.schema()` (deprecated; use `model_json_schema()`) and `cls.validate(opts)` (deprecated v1 classmethod; use `model_validate`) are still v1 calls. Note that `cls.schema()["properties"]` keys are used to filter argparse namespace keys; `model_json_schema()["properties"]` gives the same keys for simple models but aliases may differ.

Because these are outside the finding scope, I left them untouched per the rules. The file will not fully migrate until they are addressed."]"}
